## S14 Harmful map zones

Of the 103 floors of the game, 20 have cells that forbid magic and 26 have cells that lower physical or magic attack. Where a floor has them they cover a median of 10% (no magic) and 16% (lowered attack) of all the cells of its map, walls counted, at most 36% and 44%. A lowering zone multiplies attack by 0.5 to 0.75 for both sides (docs/FORMULAS.md 2.5).

## J35 Forging, S16 Forged pieces against unique ones

29 of the 551 pieces of equipment take upgrade levels (17 of them weapons with ATK, none with an enchantment of its own); the other 522 are fixed pieces with 1 to 4 enchantments and no upgrade. Each level adds `int(level * rate)` to every stat the piece has (docs/FORMULAS.md 10.1): for a weapon 5.4% to 9.7% of its base ATK a level, median 6.3%. The highest level a zone gives is 99.

| Weapon type | Best piece that takes levels | Its ATK at +0 | at the top level | Best fixed piece | Its ATK |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Claymore | 37 | 312 | Amenomurakumo | 433 |
| 1 | Kukri | 19 | 137 | Kali Kukri | 279 |
| 2 | Heavy Axe | 43 | 361 | Adamas Greatscythe | 462 |
| 3 | Heavy Lance | 39 | 321 | Trishula | 447 |
| 4 | Mace | 23 | 165 | Vajra | 258 |
| 7 | Long Bow | 38 | 242 | Ame Maka | 441 |
| 8 | Tachi | 45 | 343 | Daikingatatachi | 468 |
| 9 | Darts | 13 | 137 | Brionac | 273 |
| 10 | Whip | 23 | 165 | Gleipnir Whip | 289 |
| 11 | Ougi | 16 | 131 | Lord Mashiro's Fan | 312 |

At the top level the plain piece has more ATK than the best fixed one in 0 of 10 weapon types. What an upgrade level costs in gold is in the program and was not read.

## J36 Meals

16 meals; 10 give a buff, the others only restore or cure at once. The buff is the status of a skill at a fixed level (tools/item_effect_data.py), with the turns that skill has at that level, and on the map a turn of a status is 5 steps (docs/FORMULAS.md 12.18). So a meal lasts 15 to 50 steps; in a battle each action of its bearer takes a turn off it. The mean walk between two random battles is 18 to 28 steps by zone (median 25): a meal is worth about one battle, and reaches a boss only when the shop appears at its door.

| Meal | Price | Buff |
|---|---|---|
| Hee-ho Bar | 180 | Sun Veil Lv5: 10 turns, 50 steps |
| South Pole Shaved Ice | 260 | Water Enchant Lv5: 10 turns, 50 steps |
| Miracle Shake | 620 | Divine Shield Lv5: 4 turns, 20 steps |
| Raspberry Supreme | 840 | Aim Lv10: 9 turns, 45 steps |
| 31-Layer Ice Cream | 1000 | Circle Protect Lv5: 8 turns, 40 steps; Accelerator Lv5: 3 turns, 15 steps |
| Mapo Ramen | 80 | Fire Enchant Lv5: 10 turns, 50 steps |
| Mega-Meaty Ramen | 380 | Circle Brave Lv5: 8 turns, 40 steps |
| Ramen Carbonara | 520 | Circle Protect Lv5: 8 turns, 40 steps; Fleet Foot Lv10: 6 turns, 30 steps |
| Ultimate Champon | 980 | Stab Guard Lv5: 8 turns, 40 steps; Slash Guard Lv5: 8 turns, 40 steps; Bash Guard Lv5: 8 turns, 40 steps |
